items.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
items.summary: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]

items.title: TSMC employee data breach linked to cloud provider
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) confirmed that personal employee data has been leaked online after a threat actor put 6.9GB of information allegedly stolen from the company up for auction. [...]

items.title: Pentagon Renames CDAO ‘Super Intelligence Office’

items.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
items.summary: Cursor confirmed it suffered a security breach that let hackers distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace after stealing credentials from AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI. [...]

items.title: US disrupts North Korean campaign behind $400 million crypto theft
items.summary: The U.S. government has disrupted a North Korean social engineering campaign called 'FaceStealer', responsible for stealing more than $400 million in cryptocurrency. [...]

items.title: Apple Reveals How Secure Exclaves Shield Camera and Microphone Data

items.title: Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity?
items.summary: Overreliance on AI could erode the creativity, clear communication, and critical thinking security teams need when there’s no playbook. The post Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity? appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Meta Fined $887 Million in Italy Over Android Gallery Photos and Videos on Facebook
items.summary: The directive protects smartphones as part of a person’s private sphere and requires “free and informed consent” for such access, the authority said. The post Meta Fined $887 Million in Italy Over Android Gallery Photos and Videos on Facebook appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: No Signs of Hacking in FAA Ground Stop as FBI Reportedly Probes Software Update

items.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper

items.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
items.summary: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]

items.title: German military drone operations disrupted by cyberattack

items.title: How one AI agent exposed five critical enterprise security gaps

Token Security examines five critical AI agent security gaps and shares practical guidance from industry security leaders on preventing them. [...]

items.title: Police arrest 354 suspects in dark web cybercrime crackdown

items.summary: A new worm-like malware toolkit named SCKit was deployed in the recent ScreenConnect attacks targeting managed service providers (MSPs), designed to spread from infected customer devices to MSP technicians' computers and compromise additional managed networks. [...]
